violation_type.title: Requirements for Stacking Wall Cribs - Used Only for Infant that Cannot Stand or Can Stand Without Hitting Head (26 TAC §746.2413(2))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Stacking Wall Cribs - Used Only for Infant that Cannot Stand or Can Stand Without Hitting Head
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection an infant was observed in the bottom of a stacking crib standing with their head touching the bottom of the top crib.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection an infant was observed in the bottom of a stacking crib standing with their head touching the bottom of the top crib.
I observed 2 thirteen month olds in stacking cribs who`s head was touching the ceiling.     Note: The director removed both children from the lower portion of the cribs during the inspection.

One infant was observed in a stacking crib standing up and hitting his head on the crib above his.  This was corrected when the caregiver removed the infant from the crib and agreed to use a different crib for the infant.
